title: Trump names his ‘Super Intelligence Force’ headed by spy chief Jay Clayton.
summary: As the new AI czar , Clayton will lead a team that includes FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson, Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering Emil Michael, and Office of Personnel Management Director Scott Kupor.
